description.zh: 把节点的实时状态做成图片：小徽章、单节点卡片和全部节点的状态看板，可以贴到 README、论坛签名或网站里。
description.en: Live node status as images: small badges, a card per node and a board of all nodes, to embed in a README, a forum signature or a site.

name.zh: 状态看板最多显示的节点数
name.en: Most nodes shown on the board

name.zh: 在卡片和看板上显示 CPU、内存、磁盘和网速
name.en: Show CPU, memory, disk and network on cards and the board

help.zh: 关闭后图片只显示在线状态和可用率。
help.en: When off, images show only whether nodes are up and their availability.
